topic: From Tangents to Infinity: Newton's Method and Fractals

sections.title: Prerequisites: The Geometry of a Tangent
lecture_lines: Tangent lines approximate curves at a point.
They predict where the curve crosses the axis.
This allows us to estimate roots numerically.
animations: Draw a function curve f(x) in #FFFFFF.
Add a point x0 and vertical line to the curve.
Draw a tangent line at (x0, f(x0)) in #FF00FF.
Show the intersection x1 of the tangent and x-axis.
Label x0, x1, and the tangent line clearly.

sections.title: Newton’s Method: The Iterative Search
lecture_lines: Newton's formula iteratively improves our guess.
We calculate the next point using the derivative.
Repeating this refines the root estimate rapidly.
animations: Display initial guess x0 on the x-axis.
Draw the tangent line at current guess.
Animate the jump to the next guess x1.

sections.title: The Basin of Attraction
lecture_lines: Your starting guess decides which root you find.
The number line divides into basins of attraction.
Points near boundaries jump between different roots.
animations: Show a plane colored by basins of attraction.
Highlight a point converging to a specific root.
Slowly change the starting point across the plane.

sections.title: From Roots to Fractals: Newton's Fractal
lecture_lines: Extend this process to the complex plane.
Initial guesses now lead to different complex roots.
Fractal patterns emerge along the basin boundaries.
Even small shifts cause wildly different outcomes.
This illustrates extreme sensitivity to initial conditions.
animations: Overlay a grid on the basin of attraction map.
Color pixels based on the final converged root.
Zoom into a boundary area to show self-similarity.
Display the final fractal output clearly.

sections.title: Conclusion and Intuition
lecture_lines: Simple rules create infinite, beautiful complexity.
Chaos thrives at the meeting of basins.
Newton's method reveals structure within the unknown.
animations: Show the transition from linear to complex iteration.
Highlight the boundary between different basins.
